sources.title: PDF Sentiment Analysis of IMDb Reviews Using DistilBERT and a Custom ...
sources.snippet: We used the IMDb movie review dataset as a test dataset and employed DistilBERT to generate fixed-length contextual embeddings to subsequently pass into a feedforward neural network that we built in PyTorch. We conducted multiple rounds of experimentation to adjust the hyperparameters of learning rate, batch size, and model depth and width.
